quest.title: Stride on Rainbows, Split the Waves
quest.description: Near the People of the Springs, you meet Rongo, who wants to test the training grounds...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, what a pretty shell! Why's it on this platform anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Why, hey there, {M#kane}{F#wahine}. Impeccable timing! You got a moment?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, someone's here! Well, {NICKNAME}, guess we should hear what he has to say...?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Hey there, {M#kane}{F#wahine}. Impeccable timing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? You talking to us?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: That's right! You're outlanders from far abroad, yes? I've got something I'd like your opinion on.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: From the perspective of a guest, have you ever thought that the life the People of the Springs lead is too laid-back?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, what do you mean by that?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Well, something you should know is that our ancestors were warriors famed throughout the lands. Uenuku the Treader of the Rainbow, Tupac the Giant... Renowned heroes all!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: But nowadays? Mention "the People of the Springs," and people assume you're talking about "hot springs"!

choices.text: Is that such a bad thing?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Hardly, no, but all this easy living will see our fighting spirit vanish in time, mark my words!

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: This can't go on! That's why I told lil' Amina that we've gotta build a training ground — to stoke that spirit once more!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, what did she say?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: "I don't get what you're saying at all, but if it's interesting, we'll go along with it."

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: So, this is it! The Great Training Arena of the People of the Springs!

choices.text: "Great," you say...?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: #Haha, and that's where you're underestimating the genius behind this design, {M#kane}{F#wahine}! Did you think these were just simple wooden racks?

choices.text: And what are they, if not that?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Well! These racks are used in surfing training, which makes them far from ordinary!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So they were racks, after all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And speaking of which, doesn't that make your "training" surfing practice? How's that got anything to do with "fighting spirit"?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: That's where you're rating surfing too low! "Winning hearts is as hard as conquering the tides" — bet you're remembering that famous quote from the great hero Uenuku right about now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hold your horses right there, man! Never mind if you made that quote up or not. Forget "fighting spirit" — is this even all that related to "surfing"?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Ah, do the details matter? We hone our surfing skills to sharpen our wills — that's a longstanding tribal tradition, and not to be abandoned!

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: And now that we're here, my good outlander guests, wanna try out some surfing training sometime soon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why not now?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: #Because this training ground isn't ready for use yet. And if you must know why, {M#kane}{F#wahine}... You've seen those Flowcurrent Birds, aye?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: They've got thick skin and sturdy flesh, and don't get hurt even if you boop them into the air. On the flip side, if new hands get booped into the water by them too often, they might lose interest in surfing altogether.

choices.text: Well, sure...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we just need to chase those Flowcurrent Birds away, right? That way, this training ground can operate normally.

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: #Haha, aye, that'd be great, {M#kane}{F#wahine}! Let's see, what should we do for someone who's helping to set up our Great Training Arena of the Springs... Ah, got it!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Rongo climbs up to a makeshift wooden platform set up nearby and grabs a shell...

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Here. You can have this!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, it's so pretty!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Alrighty then, {NICKNAME}. Let's help get these birds outta the way!

choices.text: Couldn't you consider this a special feature of this training ground?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Haha, that's a great idea, really! Let me think. For example, if we could lure one of those big, fierce Flowcurrent Birds to the first rack, it could knock a newbie back to the starting point in one hit...

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: While veterans who have mastered surfing would know how to get around it or use their strength to knock said birds into the air. Haha, yes! The cruelty of surfing made manifest!

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Still, lil' Amina would like this site to be open to a larger audience... So I'll save your suggestion for when we design a second one!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, that sounds kinda dangerous. You sure this is a good idea?

choices.text: S—So you mean...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, so if you adjust those racks to the correct positions, the water will part to reveal the real training grounds beneath — a grand hall several hundred meters deep... or something like that?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Hahaha. What sort of imagination have you got? Do I look like I have the time to dig so deep a hole and block it off with some simplistic mechanisms? Does anyone?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Anyway! These racks are used in surfing training. That's what makes them extraordinary!

choices.text: It's a bunch of wooden racks...
Well, people also think about music...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And about delicious fruit juice...

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: That's all the same to me! This easy living will see our fighting spirit vanish in time — mark my words!

talks.objective: Help Rongo chase the Flowcurrent Birds away

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Ho there! Have you driven all those Flowcurrent Birds off?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Haha, awesome! Good job, {M#kane}{F#wahine}! That squares our basic prep away — now, we can start testing our Great Training Arena!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Well, are you ready?

dialogues.text: Alright, let's begin.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Haha, mighty straightforward of ya! Now that's the spirit our people lack right now, y'know? Righty then. I'll make the preparations now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a bit, I've got something else I need to do.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #No problem! I'll go fix the wooden racks a bit and wait here for your return, {M#kane}{F#wahine}!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Haha, such skill! If all our kids were half as nimble as you, {M#kane}{F#wahine}, they wouldn't need training.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: And here's the shell you were promised. Take it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, just glad we could help.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Still, now that you've finished testing, I've realized that there's a serious problem...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What would that problem be?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Don't you think... this is just a real regular surfing spot?

choices.text: And what did you think it would be otherwise?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: #Well, uh... You see the Spiritdoors over there, {M#kane}{F#wahine}? When Amina and I were discussing this whole affair, these old Phlogiston Devices still operated normally.

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: *sigh* If they could still be used to activate those Spiritways, we could've ridden them straight up to the rainbow, just like Uenuku once did!

choices.text: I see...

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: It's just a shame that these devices don't work right anymore.

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Normally, there should be <color=#00E1FFFF>inscriptions</color> regarding the repair of these ancient Phlogiston Devices near them. Maybe these are exceptions.

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: And I'm a whole bunch of things, but Phlogiston Scholar isn't one of them, so I've gotta call someone else in to fix this later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Speaking of that, Chikya probably knows how to fix these, right? But we don't know where she is right now...)

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: #Anyway, you have my thanks, {M#kane}{F#wahine}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that's kind of a shame. Why don't we snoop around the area? Maybe we can find some way to fix 'em Spiritdoors!

choices.text: Paimon can just fly straight up there, Spiritway or no.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, that's right, that's right! ... Actually, what are you getting competitive for?

choices.text: Illumination at last...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, let's begin.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Alright, let me do some prep work first!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a bit, I've got something else I need to do.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #No problem! I'll go fix the wooden racks a bit and wait here for your return, {M#kane}{F#wahine}!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Ohh! Ohhh! I... didn't expect you to actually fix those doors! You... You've got spirit alright! Lots of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, how should Paimon put this, though? We've reactivated the devices, but Paimon thinks they need partial readjusting...

choices.text: Any ideas?

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: Haha, no worries! Leave those details to me!

response.speaker: Rongo
response.text: You just come back around tomorrow, alright?

choices.text: I blame Paimon for not flying me across.

talks.objective: Look around nearby for a way to repair the Spiritdoors

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Seems like the Spiritway's shut again...

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Haha, no worries, no worries! It was fixed once, it can be fixed again! You just enjoy yourself, {M#kane}{F#wahine}!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Our current Training Arena is meant to hone young people and their fighting spirit, in any case... So this is more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: If you've got the time and the mind to hone your spirit, feel free to come back!

talks.objective: Check on the Great Training Arena of the Springs

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, let's begin.

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Alright, let's not wait longer than we need to, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Aha, you're back! Behold, the ultimate, enhanced "Great Training Arena of the Springs"!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {M#kane}{F#wahine}? Ready to hop aboard a Spiritway?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back! Ready to test the Great Training Arena site?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Oh ho, you're back! What's good? Been full of fighting spirit lately, I hope?

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: Now it's a shame, but I haven't yet found a scholar who can repair these Spiritdoors. But it's alright. We'll just wait and see for now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Hold on, I need a moment. I'll be right back...

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: No worries! Tell me when you're ready to start!

dialogues.speaker: Rongo
dialogues.text: #Just leave the track adjustments to me, {M#kane}{F#wahine}. You just come back around tomorrow, alright?
